Round 25 numbers from the owner's PC (--own-assets --quick): kept (rebuild) page 84.8%, canvas 86.3%; replay canvas 94.7%, page 85.1%; rebuild vs replay 90.6%. Scored against the canvas copied at the recorded frame because the loader's overlay covers it. After PR #19 a fresh capture still kept the black '63' loader as the reference (the loader had no loader-like name, so the watch did not see it); Round 27 detects a bare counter on a full-screen layer. After PR #20: still the black '64' loader (counter crawls 63 -> 64 and stalls on software WebGL; quick mode stopped at its hard cap). Round 28: quick mode follows a rising counter up to 180 s, and a loader still up at the end is hidden so the reference shows the page behind it. After PR #21: still the '88' loader (--own-assets) and '36' (--no-replay, now warned at any score). Owner measured: div.loader finishes on SwiftShader (19% at 43 s -> 92% at 153 s, gone by 165 s) and LOADER_HIDE at 60 s shows the laid-out hero, but the watch clock started at page load and slow first screenshots ate the hard cap. Round 29: clock from the first watch frame, look through a flat loader in the loop, per-poll loader reasons in the timings. After PR #22: the real hero is the reference in both modes (--own-assets at 161.7 s, --no-replay at 163.4 s, page 99.2%), loader false, not flat. New gap: no WebGL canvas on that first screen (hero still a poster image, layout canvas null, nothing recorded); Round 30 waits up to 60 s (quick) for a drawing canvas after the loader, with one pointer/scroll nudge. After PR #23 on a 2-vCPU no-GPU box: reference is the real hero (162.8 s) but no WebGL after the loader. Measured: 3 contexts and one 1440x900 canvas while the loader is up, 0 canvases after; the site's main JS picks a tier from navigator.hardwareConcurrency (>= 8 high, else mid). Round 31: the GPU mask also answers 8 cores / 8 GB, and recording is skipped when no canvas draws after the loader. After PR #24 on the 2-vCPU box: core mask works (8 cores, 8 GB) but the hero still goes static: the canvas draws only under the loader; KHR_parallel_shader_compile unsupported -> CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL -> TypeError at addPass in the site's post chain, html class 'vscroll static', poster fallback. Recording skipped (90 s saved). Round 32 reports masks, lost contexts and the fallback class
